def _crear(client, auth, inicio):
    r = client.post(
        "/reservas",
        json={"sala": "Atlas", "inicio": inicio, "duracion_min": 60},
        headers=auth,
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    return r.json()


def test_filtra_desde_una_fecha(client, auth):
    _crear(client, auth, "2026-10-05T10:00")
    _crear(client, auth, "2026-10-06T10:00")
    _crear(client, auth, "2026-10-08T10:00")

    r = client.get("/reservas", params={"desde": "2026-10-06"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    inicios = [res["inicio"] for res in r.json()]
    assert inicios == ["2026-10-06T10:00:00", "2026-10-08T10:00:00"]


def test_incluye_reserva_del_mismo_dia(client, auth):
    _crear(client, auth, "2026-10-06T08:00")

    r = client.get("/reservas", params={"desde": "2026-10-06"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert len(r.json()) == 1


def test_desde_con_formato_invalido_devuelve_422(client, auth):
    _crear(client, auth, "2026-10-06T08:00")

    r = client.get("/reservas", params={"desde": "06-10-2026"})
    assert r.status_code == 422


def test_sin_desde_devuelve_todas(client, auth):
    _crear(client, auth, "2026-10-05T10:00")
    _crear(client, auth, "2026-10-08T10:00")

    r = client.get("/reservas")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert len(r.json()) == 2
